name: Gratitude & Reflection Meditation
equipment: A quiet space and a comfortable seat
instructions: Settle into a comfortable seated position, close your eyes, and take several deep, grounding breaths.
Bring to mind three to five things you're grateful for, taking time to picture each in detail and notice the feeling it brings.
Reflect on a person who has positively influenced your life, and silently offer them thanks, even if only in your mind.
Consider a recent difficulty, and gently explore whether any growth or lesson can be appreciated within it.
Notice how your body feels as gratitude accumulates — warmth, openness, ease — and rest in that feeling for a moment.
Set an intention to carry this sense of appreciation with you through the rest of your day.
Take a final deep breath, and slowly open your eyes when ready.
